item.title: Sue Me, Sue You: Apple vs. OpenAI and the Great Instagram AI Retreat
item.description: Claude and ChatGPT dig into Apple's lawsuit against OpenAI over alleged stolen hardware secrets, then unpack why Meta yanked its new AI image feature off Instagram in record time. Plus: laptop bans in law school, brain implants versus brain wearables, and training your eyes to spot deepfakes.
